purpose: Provide one executable FrozenInterval trajectory that composes the accepted fixture-local environment, air-data, aero, propulsion, current mass, Closure and rigid-core profiles.

provenance.notes: This is a direct executable composition of accepted R0 profiles. Product and Legacy runtime APIs are absent from the executable path.

expected_facts.claim: One identity-bound sampled boundary produces uniform environment, air data, aerodynamic and propulsion wrenches, current mass properties and one normalized force/moment closure.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Identity and tick relationships are exact; finite formula values use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The independent C++17 RK4 step matches the 80-digit Decimal constant-acceleration trajectory and reaches the ExactGrid terminal at tick 1 while using the current committed mass.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Terminal identity is exact; position, velocity, orientation and angular rate use the declared field tolerances.

expected_facts.claim: Quaternion sign leaves the physical result unchanged, while cross-component identity errors, invalid core inputs, wind addition, early candidate visibility and double moment transport fail directly.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Rejection identity is exact; tolerance cannot repair an invalid identity, time relationship, mass or quaternion.

acceptance: The bundle executes the sampled-to-interval-to-commit path across all seven accepted fixture-local consumers
The Decimal analytic reference and C++17 RK4 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Canonical assets, product metrics and post-candidate mass geometry remain outside this slice
